sourceNote.zh: 此图层呈现 HALC 的 1500 年横截面，保留各地方单元及并列归属。NAME 使用现代语言的规范拼写；NAME_EXT 是细分说明，其中部分服务于后期统计对照，阅读时应结合其注明的年代。边界由近同期与非同期历史重建、现代边界、地理要素及历史地块等不同资料整理而成，点击单元可查重建依据与文献。QUALITY 说明资料类型，不是米级误差或精度排序；TIME_START 与 TIME_END 用于区分跨期数据实例，不表示边界的精确生效或终止日期。此区域图层仅覆盖资料收录范围。
sourceNote.en: This layer presents HALC’s 1500 cross-section, retaining local units and multiple attributions. NAME uses standardized modern-language spelling. NAME_EXT describes subdivisions, some intended for comparison with later statistics; read it with its stated dates. Boundaries draw on near- and non-contemporary historical reconstructions, modern boundaries, geographic features and historical cadastral divisions. Select a unit to inspect its reconstruction basis and references. QUALITY identifies source types, not metre-level error or an accuracy ranking; TIME_START and TIME_END distinguish dated data instances rather than exact dates when boundaries took effect or ended. Coverage is limited to the areas included in the source.
